english.title: Fail to comply with a section 35 direction excluding a person from an area

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: anti social behaviour crime and policing act 2014

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply with a direction given to you under section 35 of the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014 in that you

(A)_[failed to leave the locality specified, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCALITY..)]_
(B)_[returned to the locality specified or part of it, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCALITY / PART OF LOCALITY..), within the exclusion period specified in the direction]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39(1) and (2) of the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014.
